CREATE FUNCTION CDN.PobierzMagAdres(@Adres int) RETURNS varchar(24) AS BEGIN DECLARE @Wynik as varchar(24)
SELECT @Wynik = CASE WHEN isnull(MgO_Kod,'brak') = 'brak' then 'Nieznane' ELSE MgO_Kod + '-' + MgA_Segment1 + '-' + MgA_Segment2 + '-' + MgA_Segment3 + CASE WHEN MgA_Segment4 <>'' THEN '-' + MgA_Segment4 ELSE '' END END FROM CDN.MagObszary JOIN CDN.MagAdresy ON MgO_Id=MgA_MgOId WHERE MgA_ID = @Adres RETURN @Wynik END
